title: Local residue-field criterion for universal injectivity
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a local ring and $u:M\to N$ an $R$-linear map. If $M$ is projective over $R$, $N$ is flat over $R$, and the induced map $M/\mathfrak mM\to N/\mathfrak mN$ is injective, then $u$ is universally injective: for every $R$-module $L$, the map $L\otimes_R M\to L\otimes_R N$ is injective [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. Tensor products have the meaning of [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product].

proof.text: By [lem-trf-projective-over-local-free], choose a basis $(e_b)_{b\in B}$ of $M$, with no finiteness assumption on $B$ [def-weil-pbc-free-module].

Flatness of $N$ supplies injectivity on tensoring an injection [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]; [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-right-exact] supplies the remaining exactness. Thus tensoring with $N$ preserves short exact sequences. Apply [lem-kun-lazard-flat-module] to obtain a small nonempty directed poset $I$, finite free modules $F_i$, transitions $t_{ij}$, and a colimit cocone $q_i:F_i\to N$.

For finite $E\subset B$, let $P_E$ be its basis span, $a_E:P_E\to M$ inclusion, and $p_E:M\to P_E$ the coordinate projection [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Since $p_Ea_E=1$, the same identity holds modulo $\mathfrak m$; hence $\bar a_E$ is injective. The composite $\overline{ua_E}=\bar u\bar a_E$ is therefore injective. Apply [lem-trf-residue-injective-finite-free-stage-retractions] to $v=ua_E$ and the cocone of step 2: it gives $i_E$, $v_E$ with $q_{i_E}v_E=ua_E$, and a retraction of $t_{i_Ej}v_E$ for every $j\ge i_E$.

proof.text: The basis of step 1, the fixed directed colimit cocone of step 2, and the lifts and retractions for every finite $E$ from step 3 satisfy all hypotheses of [lem-trf-free-map-colimit-split-lifts-tensor-injective]. It yields injectivity of $1_L\otimes u$ for every $R$-module $L$, which is precisely universal injectivity.
